Creates a buy order. When `PAYMENT_MOCK=true`, fulfills immediately via Point

post.description:
Debits the wallet into CLEARING, then calls Point `receive-to-sell-pool`.
If Point fails after wallet debit → `202 NEEDS_RECON` + `redeem_point_failed` pending op.

1. Optional PayOnUs name enquiry  
2. Point `settle-from-sell-pool` (burn)  
3. PayOnUs bank-transfer (or mock complete)  
On payout failure → `reverse-settle-from-sell-pool`; reverse failure → `settle_reverse_failed`.
Freezes activity briefly, hashes ledger refs, optionally attaches Point internal pools.

`action=retry` (default) finishes the forward path;
`action=compensate` undoes / restores conservation.

| opType | retry | compensate |
|--------|-------|------------|
| buy_credit_failed | credit wallet | reverse Point buy + cancel order |
| redeem_point_failed | Point receive-to-sell | WALLET_REDEEM_REV_ restore wallet |
| settle_reverse_failed | reverse-settle | mark settlement failed without reverse |
MS standardization opt-in: upserts a row keyed by JWT userID (universal ID). Idempotent.

info.title: nuMoni Gateway / Orchestration API
info.description:
nuMoni Orchestration + Frontend BFF — policy broadcast for every MS, plus the /v1 entry the product Frontend uses. Full client guide: GET /frontend/integration-guide (v1.4.0) · repo FRONTEND_GATEWAY.md · USER_JOURNEYS.md.

OpenAPI JSON: /docs/swagger.json

Frontend: use this Gateway only — Auth onboarding and money-core (Wallet / Point) are proxied here. Filter Swagger: Authentication, Wallet, Point.

Machine-readable guide: GET /frontend/integration-guide (v1.4.0) — Frontend uses only this Gateway for Auth + money-core (Wallet/Point).

Frontend onboarding — full POST bodies by user type

Base URL — set NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL to http://localhost:8000/v1 (Kong) or https://numoni-gateway-ms.fly.dev (Fly BFF). NEXT_PUBLIC_API_MOCKING=disabled.

Session — store fat JWT in numoni_session; send Authorization: Bearer . Tokens from: POST /journey/signup/verify, POST /journey/login, POST /journey/profile/* · /journey/pin.

OTP — Auth → notifications-ms (SMS always; email when address present). Mailtrap = email; Twilio / SMS_DEV_MODE = SMS. When OTP_DEV_MODE=true (Auth Fly default), responses include devOtp — use it in Swagger/FE without real SMS. Resend: POST /journey/signup/otp { phone }.

Try-it-out — open Authentication - Journey → POST /journey/signup → Examples dropdown (Customer / SME / Fintech / Brand / Reseller).

Route the UI on nextStep (from signup/verify/login/me/profile/pin responses):

nextStepMeaningFE action
OTPSignup OTP challenge outstandingShow OTP screen; then POST /journey/signup/verify
LOGIN_OTPPasswordless login OTP outstandingShow OTP; resubmit POST /journey/login with phone + code
NAMECustomer needs display name (T1 done)Name form → POST /journey/profile/customer
PINCustomer name set; needs app PINPIN form → POST /journey/pin
PROFILEMerchant/reseller missing businessNameBusiness profile → POST /journey/profile/business
DASHBOARDOnboarding complete for this persona pathEnter workspace; optionally POST /policies/sync
Onboarding · Customer — CUSTOMER

phone → OTP → verify (T1 + token) → name → PIN → dashboard. Email optional at signup (profile quest later).

FE workspace: /app (consumer)

Full POST bodies below — also available as named examples on Authentication - Journey Try-it-out.

  1. 1. Signup phone — POST /journey/signup (public)
    Optional: name, firstName, lastName, email, referralCode (links to merchant). Returns nextStep OTP + optional devOtp.
    {
  "userType": "CUSTOMER",
  "phone": "08012345678",
  "referralCode": "NUM-A1B2C3"
}
  2. 2. OTP (optional resend) — POST /journey/signup/otp (public)
    Resend only. Skip if first signup response already has the code.
    {
  "phone": "08012345678"
}
  3. 3. Verify OTP — POST /journey/signup/verify (public)
    Sets KYC T1. Store accessToken. nextStep is NAME (or PIN if name already set).
    {
  "phone": "08012345678",
  "code": "123456",
  "purpose": "signup"
}
  4. 4. Name — POST /journey/profile/customer (bearer)
    Soft profile/quests: email, gender, ageGroup, work, salary, preferences, address, lat/lng, referralCode anytime.
    {
  "universalId": "replace-with-JWT-userID",
  "firstName": "Ada",
  "lastName": "Okafor",
  "name": "Ada Okafor"
}
  5. 5. Create PIN — POST /journey/pin (bearer)
    4–6 digit PIN. nextStep DASHBOARD. Lock later: POST /journey/pin/verify, PATCH /journey/lock.
    {
  "universalId": "replace-with-JWT-userID",
  "pin": "1234",
  "biometricEnabled": true
}
  6. 6. Returning login — POST /journey/login (public)
    First call may return requiresOtp + LOGIN_OTP (+ devOtp). Resubmit with phone + code → accessToken + nextStep.
    {
  "phone": "08012345678"
}

After dashboard

  • GET /journey/me — resume routing from nextStep
  • T2: Compliance (NIN/BVN + selfie) → POST /journey/kyc/tier2 or /kyc/compliance-result
  • T3: Compliance (statement + address) → POST /journey/kyc/tier3
  • POST /policies/sync — fan-out limits/permissions to MS
  • GET /consumer/account → workspace adapter (empty seed until Wallet/Point)
Onboarding · SME Merchant — SME_MERCHANT

businessName + phone + email → OTP → verify (T1) → usually DASHBOARD. Soft settings via business profile.

FE workspace: /merchant

Full POST bodies below — also available as named examples on Authentication - Journey Try-it-out.

  1. 1. SME signup — POST /journey/signup (public)
    email + businessName required. referralCode → owning reseller. In Swagger Try-it-out pick example “2 · SME Merchant”.
    {
  "userType": "SME_MERCHANT",
  "businessName": "Charles Store",
  "phone": "08012345678",
  "email": "charles@charlesstore.ng",
  "referralCode": "NUM-RESELLER"
}
  2. 2. Verify OTP — POST /journey/signup/verify (public)
    T1 + accessToken. With businessName at signup → nextStep DASHBOARD; else PROFILE.
    {
  "phone": "08012345678",
  "code": "123456",
  "purpose": "signup"
}
  3. 3. Business profile (soft) — POST /journey/profile/business (bearer)
    Optional anytime. Required path if nextStep is PROFILE.
    {
  "universalId": "replace-with-JWT-userID",
  "businessName": "Charles Store",
  "whatYouDo": "retail",
  "industry": "retail",
  "address": "24 Aminu Kano Crescent, Wuse II",
  "location": "abuja",
  "state": "Abuja",
  "city": "Wuse II",
  "latitude": 9.0765,
  "longitude": 7.3986,
  "rc": "RC1234567"
}
  4. 4. Login — POST /journey/login (public)
    First call may return requiresOtp; resubmit with code.
    {
  "phone": "08012345678"
}

After dashboard

  • T2: CAC (rc) + BVN via Compliance → POST /journey/kyc/tier2
  • T3: director ID + proof of address → /journey/kyc/tier3
  • POST /media/upload — KYC selfie/docs → CDN URL only in Mongo
  • GET /merchant/workspace → workspace adapter (empty seed until Reward OS data)
Onboarding · Fintech Merchant — FINTECH_MERCHANT

Same onboarding as SME; SK/PK issued when Tier 2 identity applies.

FE workspace: /merchant

Full POST bodies below — also available as named examples on Authentication - Journey Try-it-out.

  1. 1. Fintech signup — POST /journey/signup (public)
    Swagger example “3 · Fintech Merchant”.
    {
  "userType": "FINTECH_MERCHANT",
  "businessName": "PayLite NG",
  "phone": "08023456789",
  "email": "ops@paylite.ng",
  "referralCode": "NUM-RESELLER"
}
  2. 2. Verify OTP — POST /journey/signup/verify (public)
    Store accessToken; nextStep DASHBOARD or PROFILE.
    {
  "phone": "08023456789",
  "code": "123456",
  "purpose": "signup"
}
  3. 3. Business profile — POST /journey/profile/business (bearer)
    Soft settings; required if nextStep is PROFILE.
    {
  "universalId": "replace-with-JWT-userID",
  "businessName": "PayLite NG",
  "whatYouDo": "fintech",
  "industry": "payments",
  "email": "ops@paylite.ng",
  "phone": "08023456789",
  "website": "https://paylite.ng",
  "rc": "RC7654321"
}

After dashboard

  • T2 → POST /journey/kyc/tier2 — Fintech SK/PK via /credentials/enterprise/*
  • T3 → POST /journey/kyc/tier3
  • GET /merchant/workspace → workspace adapter (empty seed until Reward OS data)
Onboarding · Brand Merchant — BRAND_MERCHANT

Brand / FMCG merchant — same signup contract as SME.

FE workspace: /brand

Full POST bodies below — also available as named examples on Authentication - Journey Try-it-out.

  1. 1. Brand signup — POST /journey/signup (public)
    Swagger example “4 · Brand Merchant”.
    {
  "userType": "BRAND_MERCHANT",
  "businessName": "Sunrise Beverages",
  "phone": "08034567890",
  "email": "trade@sunrise.ng",
  "referralCode": "NUM-RESELLER"
}
  2. 2. Verify OTP — POST /journey/signup/verify (public)
    Store accessToken.
    {
  "phone": "08034567890",
  "code": "123456",
  "purpose": "signup"
}

After dashboard

  • T2/T3 via Compliance handoff + /journey/kyc/*
  • GET /brand/workspace → workspace adapter (empty seed until brand/reward data)
Onboarding · Reseller — RESELLER

Same signup shape as merchants (businessName + phone + email → OTP → T1 → dashboard). Owns merchants via referral codes.

FE workspace: /reseller

Full POST bodies below — also available as named examples on Authentication - Journey Try-it-out.

  1. 1. Reseller signup — POST /journey/signup (public)
    Swagger example “5 · Reseller”. Soft profile via /journey/profile/business.
    {
  "userType": "RESELLER",
  "businessName": "Lagos Channel Partners",
  "phone": "08098765432",
  "email": "ops@lagoschannel.ng"
}
  2. 2. Verify OTP — POST /journey/signup/verify (public)
    Store accessToken; route on nextStep (DASHBOARD or PROFILE).
    {
  "phone": "08098765432",
  "code": "123456",
  "purpose": "signup"
}
  3. 3. Business profile — POST /journey/profile/business (bearer)
    Optional soft profile.
    {
  "universalId": "replace-with-JWT-userID",
  "businessName": "Lagos Channel Partners",
  "whatYouDo": "distribution",
  "email": "ops@lagoschannel.ng",
  "phone": "08098765432",
  "address": "Ikeja, Lagos"
}

After dashboard

  • Share referralCode with merchants at their signup
  • GET /reseller/workspace → workspace adapter (empty seed until reseller org data)
Onboarding · Platform Admin

Not public signup. Bootstrap once via Gateway, then invite. Login via /journey/login. Full bodies in Authentication - Platform Admin Try-it-out.

  1. 1. First Platform Owner (ops only) — POST /admin/bootstrap (public)
    One-time. Use Gateway Try-it-out — no Auth Swagger needed.
    {
  "bootstrapSecret": "replace-with-PLATFORM_ADMIN_BOOTSTRAP_SECRET",
  "firstName": "Platform",
  "lastName": "Owner",
  "email": "owner@numoni.ng",
  "phone": "08000000001"
}
  2. 2. Invite another admin — POST /admin/invite (bearer)
    Bearer Platform Owner. Invitee completes phone OTP.
    {
  "firstName": "Ops",
  "lastName": "Lead",
  "email": "ops@numoni.ng",
  "phone": "08000000002",
  "role": "admin"
}
  3. 3. Admin login — POST /journey/login (public)
    OTP → accessToken. FE GET /admin/overview is analytics adapter ≠ Auth /admin/users.
    {
  "phone": "08000000001"
}

Policies — After login/KYC changes, sync policy so Wallet/Point/etc. see limits without chatty Auth calls. POST /policies/sync · GET /policies/me

Workspace adapters — Bearer workspace GETs aggregate Reward (campaigns/prizes), Card (inventory), Marketplace (storefronts). Analytics charts derive from Reward/Card when ANALYTICS_MS_URL unset. Wallet balance soft-hydrates when WALLET_MS_URL is set; full money APIs are under /wallet/* and /points/*. Examples: /merchant/workspace · /merchant/analytics · /consumer/account · /admin/overview · /reseller/workspace · /brand/workspace · /enterprise/workspace · /brand-app/account · /till/workspace. Response: { success, message, data }.

501 stubs — Remaining FE paths still return 501 FeNotImplementedDto until org adapters exist. /orgs/:orgId/settings · /orgs/:orgId/compliance. Meta: GET /access-map · GET /frontend/integration-guide.

Money core — Wallet + Point (via Gateway)

Closed-loop money APIs are proxied on this Gateway. Prefer these over calling Wallet/Point Fly URLs directly from the Frontend.

Prefixes — Wallet /wallet/* → Wallet MS /v1/*; Point /points/* → Point MS /v1/*.

Headers — Authorization: Bearer <accessToken> · Idempotency-Key: <unique per money mutation> · Content-Type: application/json · X-Correlation-ID: <optional uuid>

  • Company funds Buy Pool (mint)
    1. ADMIN JWT → POST /points/opt-in (once)
    2. POST /points/admin/mint { fiatAmount, currency, pointsToMint, rate, fundingSource } + Idempotency-Key
    3. GET /points/admin/pools to confirm BUY_POOL / totalMinted
  • Customer / merchant buy points (PayOnUs VA)
    1. POST /wallet/opt-in
    2. POST /wallet/wallets { currency: NGN }
    3. POST /wallet/wallets/{walletId}/buy-points { points, name, email, phone } + Idempotency-Key
    4. Show payment.accountNumber / bankName; poll POST /wallet/buy-orders/{id}/verify-payment or wait for webhook
    5. GET /wallet/wallets/{walletId} → balance
  • P2P / QR spend
    1. POST /wallet/transfers { fromWalletId, toWalletId, points } + Idempotency-Key
    2. or POST /wallet/qr/generate then POST /wallet/qr/confirm
  • Redeem → Sell Pool → fiat settlement
    1. POST /wallet/wallets/{walletId}/redeem { points } + Idempotency-Key
    2. Optional POST /wallet/payouts/name-enquiry { accountNumber, bankCode }
    3. POST /wallet/wallets/{walletId}/settlements { points, accountNumber, bankCode, email, accountName? } + Idempotency-Key (PayOnUs min ₦500)
    4. On payout fail, Gateway/Wallet auto reverse-settles Sell Pool (no FE compensate needed unless settle_reverse_failed recon)

Do not call from FE — Wallet PayOnUs webhook URL (server-to-server only); Point /v1/internal/* (service key; Wallet MS only); Direct Fly wallet-ms / points-ms from browser when Gateway is available.

Swagger filter — Wallet or Point for Try-it-out DTOs.

Errors — 400 Validation / bad journey state / insufficient funds; 401 Missing/invalid JWT or OTP/PIN; 403 Wrong user / non-admin; 404 Unknown user/resource; 409 Duplicate phone/email / idempotency conflict; 501 FE org stub (settings/compliance) — not Auth; 502 Auth / Wallet / Point MS unreachable from BFF proxy; 503 WALLET_MS_URL or POINT_MS_URL unset on gateway.

Gateway plumbing (proxy · policies · stubs)

Auth (proxied) — POST /journey/signup|login|…, profiles, credentials, media, and Auth platform-admin routes → Authentication MS.

Wallet (proxied) — /wallet/* → Wallet MS /v1/* (buy-points, redeem, settlements, transfers, QR, admin recon). PayOnUs webhooks stay on Wallet MS directly.

Point (proxied) — /points/* → Point MS /v1/* (opt-in, POST /points/admin/mint company Buy Pool funding, pools, recon). Internal SAM routes are not exposed.

Policies — after login/KYC, POST /policies/sync or GET /policies/me.

FE workspaces — Bearer workspace adapters; meta GET /access-map.

Bearer — fat JWT accessToken (claim userID). Shared JWT_SECRET. Money mutating routes also need Idempotency-Key.
